name: milpa/auth
description: Runtime-native identity vocabulary for the Milpa PHP framework: the typed Actor / AuthContext / AuthState / Credential primitives and the CredentialVerifier, AuthContextFactory and SessionStore contracts — the trusted producer of the context policies need. Zero framework, zero ORM, fail-closed by construction.

capability.title: Identity: turns a Bearer into an actor with scopes
capability.briefing: This app knows who calls over HTTP: there are verified actors and per-operation scopes.

suggest.milpa/tool-runtime: Defense in depth for HTTP-served operations: AuthOperationHttpPolicy runs an already-authorized request through the same PolicyGate that guards MCP.
